extractionNotes: Recall-first per Step 1. Every fixed-answer (MC or single-value fill-in-blank with a determinable correct answer) item from Year 3 and Year 5 2016 Numeracy and Language Conventions was reviewed. Items requiring a diagram/image to determine the answer (bar charts read visually, clock faces, tally marks as images, spinners, grids, folded-paper nets, balance-scale pictures where the weights are shown only as pictures, broken rulers, dot plots, area-shading grids, symmetry stars, number-line arc patterns) were excluded as 'image-dependent'. Spelling items (both years' Language Conventions Q1-25) were excluded as 'open-ended' -- they require writing a corrected spelling with no fixed set of options, not a genuine fixed-answer/MC format. Reading and Writing tests were not processed at all (see 01-source-note.json). Where an item was textually identical between Year 3 and Year 5 papers, only the Year 3 occurrence was kept and the Year 5 duplicate is logged below.

extractedItems.note: Full source text/options/answers for every usable item are recorded in research/pipeline convention as the working set behind 02-transformed.json; this section lists each source item by year/subject/question-number/topic/correct-answer for audit traceability. Verbatim source wording is intentionally not reproduced a second time here beyond what's needed for audit, consistent with this pipeline's style-inspired-not-verbatim policy; the authoritative rewritten content is in 02-transformed.json.
